about: The non-pet parts of the System Map (system-map-20261012.html): AI models, infrastructure, programs, computers and roadmap pets, plus links that cannot live in pets.json relations because one end is not a pet with a repo. Pet-to-pet links stay in pets.json relations. @pets means every registered and pipeline pet; @seeds and @roadmap mean every seed and every roadmap pet. Links to @pets reach every pet and drawn behind their own toggle. Built by scripts/system-map-20261012.mjs during npm run build. Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5), 2026-10-12. Each node has a layer from Astra's architecture chart (0 development, 1 You, 2 Program Manager and Pet Directory, 3 Friendly Farmer, 4 pet agents, 5 AI harness, 6 real programs); each link's colour is the layer it belongs to, worked out in scripts/system-map-20261012.mjs.

states.planned: Planned (decided, or in a pet's own job)

types.host: Friendly Farmer: organizes the pets (intelligent apps)
types.pipeline: Pipeline Intelligent App (Pet): repo, no art yet
types.own-program: Made by Astra: a pet's own program or a project it looks after (named after its pet)

carries.builds: code and changes made by an assistant on a branch, from a handoff card
carries.opens: opens or controls a real program
carries.model: requests to an AI model and its replies
carries.manages: looks after a real program or world: health, updates, planned work

carries.directs: your requests, decisions and approvals to an AI assistant, in conversation
carries.reports: an AI assistant answering you: results with evidence, questions only you can decide, links to what changed

nodes.name: The Farm (native OS)
nodes.job: The native OS of Astra's PetOS: the first-party home where your pets live and run, organized by the Farmer. Its face is the Farm website: a card for every pet with status, real program links and an always-visible suggestion box, reachable from any device. Your chart shows it beside You and beside the Farmer: it is one website that the Farmer runs. Planned (ASTRAS_PET_OS section 4).

nodes.name: The Kennel (community lab)
nodes.job: astras-kennel: the community lab, where other people's pets are built, tried, reviewed and adopted. Developers submit a link to their own repo; security checks and adoption happen here, and a pet only moves to the Farm with consent. Does not exist yet (ASTRAS_PET_OS, Kennel).

nodes.name: Program Manager
nodes.job: Neutral registry of every real program: links, launchers, status and capabilities, for every pet including the Farmer (ASTRAS_PET_OS section 6).

nodes.name: AI harness
nodes.job: One layer wrapped around every pet agent, drawn as the glass shell around the pets. It is the standard interface and runtime from the Astra Pet SDK: AI model adapters (Claude, GPT, local), skills and tools, memory, scheduler, inbox, communication, permissions and guardrails. Every pet, the Farmer included, runs its own copy with its own identity, but the design is shared. Pets reach AI models and real programs through it. Planned (ASTRAS_PET_OS sections 7 and 8).

0.name: Development (outside the running system)
0.detail: Assistants and scripts that build and change the pets: Claude Code, Codex and the art pipeline. They work through GitHub and handoff cards; they are not part of any pet at runtime.

1.name: You, the Human (level 4)
1.detail: You, your devices and the Farm you reach every pet from.

2.name: Program Manager and Pet Directory
2.detail: Who exists and what real programs each pet has. Today the Pet Directory is pets.json; Program Manager is planned.

3.name: Friendly Farmer
3.detail: The independent pet that organizes the pets (intelligent apps) and runs the Farm.

4.name: Pet Programs (level 2)
4.detail: Every pet: its Pet Program, the alive part that manages its Root Programs and decides when to escalate to its Agentic Harness. Registered, pipeline, seeds and roadmap.

5.name: Agentic Harness (level 3)
5.detail: Each Pet Program's own Agentic Harness: an AI model (Anthropic, OpenAI or other) is seated in it to form the Agent, when the Pet Program or the Human calls.

6.name: Root Programs (level 1)
6.detail: The external programs the pets execute and look after: the ones Astra made on their own inner shell (pink cubes), the ones made by others just outside (peach cubes). Several pets can share one Root Program.
